---
title: "Lab 1"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
DataForPlot = mtcars

#Set a serifed font
par(family = "serif")

# Create the barplot (histogram-like)
bp = barplot(table(mtcars$carb),
            space = 0,         # Changes from a barplot to a Histogram
            col = "white",     # Leaves no bar fill for a minimalist printing
            ylab = "Frequency",
            xlab = "Number of Carburetors",
            cex.lab = 1.3,    # Sets the font of the axis labels to be larger
            main = "",        # Stops the default label from being printed
            cex.names = 1,    # Optional: size axis labels: 1 is no change.
            cex.axis = 1,     # Optional: size axis numbers.
            yaxs = 'i',       # Tightens the axis to the plot.
            xaxs = 'i',
            mgp = c(2.2, 0.5, 0)  # Changes the margins around the plot;
                                  # see par(); c(axis title, axis labels and axis line)
            
            )

# Add left-justified figure "label" (bold "Figure 1")
# This should be the first thing written- in bold.
title(main = expression(bold("Figure 1")),
      adj = 0,      # 0 = left justified
      line = 3.5)    # adjusts the distance from the figure

# Add left-justified italic caption/title
# There should be a full line space between the bottom of the figure label
# and this title.
title(main = expression(italic("Frequency Distribution of Carburetors in the mtcars Dataset")),
      adj = 0,
      line = 1.8)

# Add Left-justified note. 
mtext(expression(paste(italic("Note."), " This is where the note goes.")),
      side = 1,          # bottom
      line = 3.8,        # distance below x-axis 
      adj = 0,           # 0 = left justified
      cex = .9)         # Optional: slightly smaller text for notes: 1 is no change.

#Restore default font
par(family = "")
```
